title.th: ข้อบังคับการตรวจคนเข้าเมือง (การแก้ไข) ค.ศ. 2022

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers (AGC) Malaysia — Laws of Malaysia

completenessNote: 全文：第 1 条至第 2 条；逐字未改写（源自厂商 OCR 文本）。原文马来文/英文双语并置，已分别落 text.ms 与 text.en。

text.ms:
1. (1) Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Imigresen (Pindaan) 2022.

(2) Peraturan-Peraturan ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 16 Mac 2022.

Pindaan Jadual Ketiga

2. Peraturan-Peraturan Imigresen 1963 [L.N. 228/1963], yang disebut

"Peraturan-Peraturan ibu" dalam Peraturan-Peraturan ini, dipinda dalam

Jadual Ketiga—

(a) dalam butiran V—

(i) dengan menggantikan subbutiran (vii) dengan subbutiran

yang berikut:

"(vii) For any non-Malaysian

citizen permitted by the

Government to join the

retirement programme

or Malaysia as a second

home programme

(a) RM500.00 per year or part of

a year for

an application fee

(b) RM5000.00 per issuance for

a processing fee"; dan

(ii) dengan memasukkan selepas subbutiran (vii) subbutiran

yang berikut:

"(viia) For the dependant

of the holder of

Visit Pass issued to

a non-Malaysian citizen

permitted by the

Government to join the

retirement programme

or Malaysia as a second

home programme

(a) RM500.00 per year or part

of a year for

an application fee

(b) RM2500.00 per issuance for

a processing fee"; dan

(b) dalam butiran VIII—

(i) dengan memotong perkataan "and" di hujung subbutiran (a); dan

(ii) dengan memasukkan selepas subbutiran (a) subbutiran

yang berikut:

"(aa) a processing fee for any Visit Pass issued to

a non-Malaysian citizen permitted by the Government

to join the retirement programme or Malaysia as

a second home programme in Sabah or Sarawak;

(ab) a processing fee for any Visit Pass issued to

the dependant of the holder of Visit Pass issued to a

non-Malaysian citizen permitted by the Government to join

the retirement programme or Malaysia as a second home

programme in Sabah or Sarawak; and".

Dibuat 14 Mac 2022

[KDN.IM.S-600-1/3/34; PN(PU2)100/JLD.18]

DATO' SERI HAMZAH BIN ZAINUDIN

Menteri Dalam Negeri

[Akan dibentangkan di Dewan Rakyat menurut subseksyen 54(2) Akta Imigresen 1959/63]
